name: sports-and-science
description: Use when targeting 《体育与科学》(Sports & Science, Jiangsu) — a CSSCI sport-science journal distinctive for reflective, interdisciplinary, theory-forward and methodologically self-aware scholarship (academic dialogues, critical essays, problem-and-method debates) in sport humanities & social science. Best for conceptual/critical contributions that advance how the field thinks; route empirical exercise science, applied competitive work, and standard survey社科 to the appropriate specialist venues.
